# Extra Attack (`features:barbarian-extra-attack`)
**Class:** [Barbarian](../classes/barbarian.md) | **Level:** [Barbarian 5](../levels/barbarian-5.md)

You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
